# RobinGru Svelte UI

> RobinGru Svelte UI is a token-based design system for Svelte 5 and SvelteKit. It provides 116 public components for product applications, dashboards, data-heavy views, navigation, overlays and editorial content. Its documentation site contains a live example for every component.

Important notes:

- The package is currently distributed from GitHub, not npm. Install it as `github:RobinGru/robingru-svelte-ui`, then import `@robingru/svelte-ui/styles.css` once for standalone styling.
- The system supports `data-theme="robin"`, `data-theme="robin-dark"` and `data-density="compact"`.
- Components use semantic custom properties with a `--rg-` prefix. Prefer public component props and tokens over undocumented internal selectors.
- `DataTable` is for normal to moderately large datasets. RobinGru intentionally has no VirtualTable or general enterprise grid engine.
- For a compact desktop sidebar rail, use `Sidebar` with `collapsible`, `bind:collapsed`, `collapsedHeader` and `collapsedChildren`.
- Each linked documentation entry has a Markdown counterpart at the same route with `/index.md` appended. HTML pages expose that counterpart with `rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"`.

- [Overview](./index.md): Primary entry point and documentation map.
- [Installation](./installation/index.md): GitHub installation, styles and first component.
- [Why RG Svelte UI?](./why-robingru/index.md): Positioning, strengths and intentional limits.
- [Component catalog](./components/index.md): All 116 public components and their Markdown references.
- [Patterns](./patterns/index.md): Product-like compositions for login, settings, comments and empty states.
- [Dashboard](./dashboard/index.md): KPIs, status, filters, charts and operational data views.
- [Blog & Editorial](./blog/index.md): Article, prose and post components in an editorial showcase.
- [DataTable](./data/index.md): Search, sorting, filters, selection, column controls, pagination and a detail drawer.
- [Design tokens](./tokens/index.md): Colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography and motion.
- [Accessibility](./accessibility/index.md): Keyboard, focus, form, live-region and reduced-motion examples.
- [Workbench](./workbench/index.md): Integrated application-shell showcase.

## Component references

- [Navigation and shell](./components/index.md#navigation--shell): `AppShell`, `Sidebar`, `Navbar`, `PageHeader`, `Tabs`, `Breadcrumbs` and `Pagination`.
- [Foundation](./components/index.md#grundlagen--status): `Button`, `IconButton`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Alert`, `EmptyState`, `LoadingState` and `ErrorState`.
- [Forms](./components/index.md#formulare): `FormField`, `Input`, `Checkbox`, `Select`, `DateInput`, `FileUpload` and `Dropzone`.
- [Overlays and feedback](./components/index.md#overlays--feedback): `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `CommandPalette`, `Tooltip`, `Popover` and `ToastViewport`.
- [Data components](./components/index.md#daten--strukturierte-inhalte): `DataTable`, `Table`, `DataGrid`, `Timeline` and `ActivityFeed`.
- [Dashboard components](./components/index.md#dashboard--visualisierung): `DashboardGrid`, `KpiCard`, `ChartCard`, `Sparkline`, `MiniBarChart` and `DonutChart`.
- [Editorial components](./components/index.md#blog--editorial): `Article`, `Prose`, `PostCard`, `ArticleNavigation`, `TableOfContents` and `ShareButtons`.
